**An epic's state follows its children; an all-closed open epic reads Ready to close (#1309)**

stateOf(node, work, rollup): for kind epic the rollup is evidence. Rulings: all direct children counted closed (open epic) -> new state Ready to close (◉, own tokens, AA), precedence Unreadable > Done > Blocked > Awaiting review > Ready to close > In flight > Not computed > Planned; any child closed or an open child named by work evidence -> In flight (even with closed:null); zero closed with unresolved closed issues or an unknown child state -> Not computed (Planned would claim no child closed). epicRollup gains openChildren; rollupFor(node, epics) shared by lane and roadmap models. #878 now reads In flight next to 22/53.
